suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

## Named Storms per Year

The plot below shows the number of unique named storms per year based on the `storms` dataset from the `dplyr` package.

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms
#| fig-cap: "Number of named storms per year from 1975 to the present."
storms %>%
  distinct(year, name) %>%
  count(year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0073C2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#EFC000", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Named Storms Per Year",
    subtitle = "Analysis of historical storm records",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Storm Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
